title: Notes & Sketch App
description: A local-first, cross-platform notes & sketch app for desktop, tablet, and mobile — a Flutter UI over a Rust core, with SQLite for local state and CRDT-based sync.

title: Zerodha Trading Bot
description: An automated stock-trading bot on Zerodha's Kite API — Next.js with technical-analysis signals, real-time monitoring, and risk management, backed by Prisma.
